description: Use when someone asks for the best mortgage, auto-loan, HELOC, personal-loan, student-loan, equipment-loan, or credit-card rates near them and provides a ZIP. Finds the nearest NCUA-reported branch set, keeps credit unions with a current product-matched published rate, and ranks those offers by lowest APR with approximate distance as a tie-breaker. HELOC matching excludes closed-end home-equity loans. This is a local shopping shortlist: distance is straight-line, membership is not guaranteed, and published APR is not personalized approval.

max_offers.description: Maximum product-matched offers to return (1-8, default 5).

product_type.description: Product whose current published rates should be compared.

term_months.description: Optional comparable loan term. For fixed mortgages, under 300 months selects the 15-year market and 300+ selects 30-year.

vehicle_condition.description: Auto loans only. Omit to use the new-auto market.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code used as the center of the nearby-branch search.

name: find_product_rates_near_zip

disclosure.description: Precision and methodology caveat for the distances and locations above; carry it into any answer that quotes them.

nearby_credit_union_count.description: How many credit unions were found near this ZIP before filtering to those publishing this product; `offers` is usually shorter.

offers.description: Published offers from nearby credit unions, ordered by the rule in `ranked_by`.

apr.description: Annual percentage rate in percent, including lender fees. NULL when the lender published no APR — the API deliberately does not substitute the note rate, so never present `rate` as an APR. Some legacy rows still carry an APR equal to the note rate; those heal on that credit union's next scrape.

branch.description: The nearest branch (name and street address) that the distance was measured to.

credit_union_id.description: Internal composite identifier 'name|city|STATE' for the lender.

display_name.description: Normalized product name for comparison across lenders, e.g. '30-Year Fixed'. Prefer this when comparing; quote product_name when citing the lender.

distance_method.description: Precision of the distance: 'branch_coordinate' (exact branch geocode) or 'zip_centroid' (coarser, branch ZIP only).

distance_miles.description: Straight-line miles from the ZIP centroid to the nearest branch, not driving distance. Null when no branch geocode is available.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp when this specific rate was last scraped from the lender.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product, e.g. '30 Year Fixed - Conforming'.

proximity.description: How the lender qualified as nearby: 'same_zip' or 'distance'.

rate.description: Note rate in percent (6.125 = 6.125%), excluding fees.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this credit union.

precision.description: Overall precision of the distance estimates, e.g. 'ZIP-centroid straight-line estimate'.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

ranked_by.description: The ordering rule applied to `offers`, e.g. lowest APR among credit unions with nearby reported branches — proximity filters the set, price sorts it.

unavailable_reason.description: Why `offers` is empty, present only when it is — e.g. no credit union near that ZIP publishes the requested product. Quote this rather than telling the user no rates exist.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code the search was centered on.
